fields.meta_title: Style Quiz: Find Your Style, Then Build Your Own | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Take a free style quiz that names your fashion style, then build your own for a clothing shop or a design studio.
fields.h1: Build a Style Quiz That Matches Every Answer to a Style
fields.hero_description: Take the eight-question style quiz below, or build a style quiz for your store that saves every answer to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Your Style Quiz Does After the Last Answer
fields.features_subheading: Six parts Emergent builds from one prompt. Change any of them by describing the change.
fields.feature_1:
Questions written around your results

Name the styles you want to sort people into, such as Classic or Bohemian. Emergent writes the questions, maps every option to one result, and rewords any of them on request.
fields.feature_2:
Every finished quiz saved as a row

Each finished quiz becomes a row in a database you own, holding the result, every option picked, and an email if one was given. Filter by result to see which style draws people.
fields.feature_3:
Results linked to your catalog

Connect your store or catalog tool through its API and tag products by style. The result screen then shows the in-stock pieces that carry that tag instead of a generic list.
fields.feature_4:
Alerts for the person who follows up

Send a Slack or email alert when a result needs a person, such as a stylist before a first session or a designer who takes one style. The alert carries every answer.
fields.feature_5:
No cap on quiz takers

Emergent puts no cap on responses. A quiz sent in a newsletter to 30,000 readers records every result, and no answer is cut off at a plan limit or charged one by one.
fields.feature_6:
A quiz on your domain, code in GitHub

Publish the quiz on your own domain or a subdomain of your shop, included with Emergent and paid in credits. Paid plans add full code export to your GitHub repository.

fields.tab_content_1:
A Romantic result opens on matching pieces

Lena Brooks finishes the style quiz on Hollis Lane's site with Romantic. The result screen shows the 4 in-stock pieces the store tagged Romantic, pulled from its catalog. Her result and email are saved to the store's customer table, and the next newsletter she gets leads with lace and florals.
fields.tab_content_2:
What the stylist knows before Thursday

Booking a first session sends the style quiz with the confirmation. Dana Whitfield answers on Monday: Classic, size 8, and a $400 budget for the season. Her stylist, Ines Varga, gets an email with every answer before Thursday's call and pulls navy blazers before Dana walks in.
fields.tab_content_3:
Each decor style has its own designer

Fernwood Interiors puts a home decor style quiz on its site, with a room and budget question at the end. Each result routes to the designer who takes that style. Carla Mendez lands on Farmhouse with a $22,000 kitchen budget, and her lead goes to Theo Marsh, who takes every Farmhouse result.
fields.tab_content_4:
Ordering spring blazers from 2,400 results

Over the fall, 2,400 shoppers finished Ashby Menswear's style quiz. Classic led with 920 results, ahead of Sporty at 610, Minimal at 540, and Rugged at 330. The buyer read that split in October and doubled the spring blazer order.

fields.howto_title: How to Make a Style Quiz
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to make a style quiz whose results name a style and lead somewhere useful, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write the results before the questions
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Keep it short enough for a phone
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pick between three and six styles and write a short description of each, with the pieces or rooms that belong to it. Questions come faster once you know where each answer should lead, because every option needs a result to point to.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask what people wear and buy: the shoes they wear most, or the jacket they grab on a cool night. Concrete picks sort people more cleanly than asking them to rate themselves as stylish or bold, which invites the flattering answer.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Map one option to each result in every question. That way any style can win. Keep the options the same kind and length. A silly answer next to four real ones tells people which to skip, and that option stops counting.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Hold the quiz to eight or ten questions with one question per screen, short enough to finish on a phone in one sitting. Show a progress bar so people can see how close they are to the result.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the style, not the person
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write each result as a description of the style: your answers lean toward lace and soft colors. Then add two or three pieces to buy or rooms to start with. The result screen should give the person something to try.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Choose what happens after the result screen: a product list tagged with that style, or an email to the stylist or designer who takes it. Put that in your prompt, and Emergent builds the routing along with the quiz.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test every result before you share it
fields.howto_step_7_des: Take the quiz once for each result, picking the options that point to it, and confirm that result wins. Then check the saved row and any email it sends before the link goes into a newsletter or onto your site.

faq_plan.a: A style quiz is a short set of questions about what you wear or how you decorate, scored so your answers point to one named style, such as Classic or Bohemian. The quiz on this page asks eight questions and names one of five fashion styles.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a style quiz?
faq_plan.a: Write down the styles you want as results, then describe the quiz in a prompt, including what happens after each result. Emergent's AI survey builder drafts each question with one option per result and stores each finished quiz in your own database. Publish it and share the link.

faq_plan.q: What does a fashion style quiz ask about your clothes?
faq_plan.ref: what is my clothing style quiz
faq_plan.a: It asks about real choices in your closet: the shoes you wear most, the colors you buy, and the fabric you reach for first. The quiz on this page maps each pick to a style and names the one your clothing choices lean toward.

faq_plan.q: What does a home design style quiz ask?
faq_plan.ref: what is my home design style quiz
faq_plan.a: A home design style quiz asks about the fixed parts of a house you would live with for years: ceiling height, window shape, trim, and flooring. The result names a design direction, such as Craftsman or Modern Farmhouse, that a builder or architect can start the first sketches from.

faq_plan.q: Where can you take a free style quiz?
faq_plan.ref: how to find your style quiz free
faq_plan.a: On this page. The style quiz above is free and asks for no account or email. Your result names the style your picks lean toward and lists pieces to build around it. To run a quiz of your own, Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What does a decorating style quiz ask?
faq_plan.ref: what is my decorating style quiz
faq_plan.a: A decorating style quiz asks about the rooms you are drawn to: the sofa shape you would pick, wood or painted finishes, and open shelves or closed cabinets. Each answer points to a style such as Farmhouse or Coastal, and the result names the one your picks favor.

faq_plan.q: What is a home decor style quiz?
faq_plan.ref: what is my home decor style quiz
faq_plan.a: A home decor style quiz names the look a person leans toward for their home, and for a design studio it doubles as a lead form. Ask which room comes first and what they plan to spend, and the result arrives with what a designer needs for the first call. Emergent puts no cap on how many leads the quiz records.

faq_plan.q: What is a home style quiz?
faq_plan.ref: what is my home style quiz
faq_plan.a: A home style quiz names the kind of house a person pictures, starting with the outside: a bungalow with a deep porch, or a modern house with tall windows. A builder or real estate agent can send one before a first meeting and open with listings that fit the result.

faq_plan.q: What is a fashion style quiz with pictures?
faq_plan.ref: what is my fashion style quiz with pictures
faq_plan.a: It is a style quiz where every option is a photo of an outfit, a pair of shoes, or a fabric swatch instead of a written description. Pictures help when a choice is hard to put into words, such as two shades of blue or two jacket cuts. Shoot every option on the same plain background. The clothes are then the only thing that differs.

faq_plan.q: How does a style quiz for interior design work?
faq_plan.ref: what is my interior design style quiz
faq_plan.a: An interior design style quiz shows people photos of rooms and furniture, then names the design style their picks favor, such as Scandinavian or Industrial. Use a picture for every option, since a room says more than a style name. Emergent builds the quiz and the database behind it from one prompt.

quiz.intro: Eight questions about the clothes you reach for. Your result names the fashion style your answers lean toward, with pieces to build it around.

results.title: Classic
results.description: Your answers lean toward tailored shapes, crisp cotton, and deep traditional colors. Build around a well-cut blazer, straight trousers, and leather loafers. Add one patterned shirt or silk scarf each season.

results.title: Minimalist
results.description: Your answers lean toward solid neutrals, clean lines, and fewer pieces that all work together. Pick three base colors, buy each staple in the best fabric you can afford, and skip prints unless one earns its place.

results.title: Bohemian
results.description: Your answers lean toward loose layers, earthy colors, and handmade or vintage finds. Mix a flowing skirt or dress with suede, crochet, and stacked jewelry, and look in secondhand stores first.

results.title: Streetwear
results.description: Your answers lean toward relaxed fits, sneakers, and graphic pieces with a current edge. Start from an oversized hoodie, cargo pants, and one standout pair of sneakers, and let a single bright accent carry the outfit.

results.title: Romantic
results.description: Your answers lean toward soft fabrics, pastel colors, and details like lace, bows, and puff sleeves. Build on midi dresses and blouses in blush or cream, and finish with delicate jewelry.

scope.evidence: H1 "Build a Style Quiz That Matches Every Answer to a Style"; hero "Take the eight-question style quiz below, or build a style quiz for your store that saves every answer to a database you own." (D1 met); how-to description one sentence under 140 characters.

intent.evidence: Top 10 is consumer find-your-style quizzes; the page carries a playable 8-question matching quiz ("Find Your Fashion Style", five results, every result reachable: each question maps one option to each of the five keys), plus four business examples and a seven-step how-to.

specificity.evidence: Tabs speak the buyer's vocabulary: "4 in-stock pieces the store tagged Romantic", "Classic, size 8, and a $400 budget for the season", "$22,000 kitchen budget", "doubled the spring blazer order". Table competitors are a note.

openers.evidence: Every paragraph opens on a full sentence: "Name the styles you want to sort people into", "Booking a first session sends the style quiz with the confirmation.", "Over the fall, 2,400 shoppers finished Ashby Menswear's style quiz."

craft.evidence: No tacked-on endings or from-to ranges; QC Q5/Q7 clean. Q8 list count (10) is a P2 note only.

voice.evidence: Plain product verbs and unglamorous detail: "pulls navy blazers before Dana walks in", "Classic led with 920 results, ahead of Sporty at 610". Repetition of "result" is a note.

truth.evidence: Emergent claims map to claims_used (prompt-build, database-owned, api-connect, alerts, no-caps, code-export, custom-domain, free-start): "included with Emergent and paid in credits", "Paid plans add full code export to your GitHub repository", "the free tier covers building and publishing". 920+610+540+330 = 2,400. Quiz claims check: "eight questions and names one of five fashion styles" matches spec.quiz (8 questions, 5 results); "asks for no account or email" matches the embed (no requests). Quiz is matching type, results framed "Your answers lean toward ...", no diagnosis or stated facts needing a source.

distinct.evidence: Body and tabs are fashion/decor-specific (Hollis Lane, Fernwood Interiors, Ashby Menswear); no sibling primary in any heading.

faq.evidence: Two of the 10 FAQ items leave the page's sense of "style quiz" (clothing/home style) and answer other pages' topics: item 9 "Is there a style quiz for how you learn?" (sibling /learning-style-quiz) and item 4 "What does an attachment style quiz measure?" (relationship behaviour, /relationship-quiz territory). Also 0 related-page links (note).

images.evidence: Contact sheet: one hero per tab, names and numbers match copy word for word (Lena Brooks/Romantic/4 pieces; Dana Whitfield Classic, Size 8, $400, Ines Varga, Before Thursday; Carla Mendez Farmhouse $22,000 to Theo Marsh; 2,400 / 920 / 610 / 540 / 330, Spring blazer order doubled, October).
